note: Owner-editable additions to the finite mutation boundary of this installation. Paths are relative to the installation root, must name one existing regular file each and never leave the root; productRoots names directories inside the root that hold a Keel Harness product source tree (each carries .claude/shell-mutation-guard.js), under which that product's own verifiers, tests and tools run without confirmation; mcpWriteTools.allow lists exact MCP tool names (mcp__<server>__<tool>) that may run while a package is active; publishProjects names project repositories inside the root (each one real directory with its own .git) whose current branch an agent may publish through git-intent without a closed package: an entry is the Owner's general OK for that project, pushes are always fast-forward to origin, never forced. Invalid entries block execution fail-closed. Agents do not edit this file (write-guard W4); the installer keeps it across upgrades.
